title: Event lanyard and badge
slide_intent: Keep a person’s identity legible within a recognizable event credential, because the badge must help people identify one another.
strategic_value: The green strap and badge can connect an individual attendee to Channel 4 without competing with their name.
demonstration: A green lanyard clip holds a transparent badge against black clothing; the insert places a 4 above the name Orla McCool and smaller National Comedy Awards 2023 text.
practical_value: Choose a clear hierarchy between brand, attendee name and event details on a badge.

content_islands.name: Lanyard attachment
content_islands.spec: Show the green strap and clip joining the clear badge holder.

content_islands.name: Badge hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Position the small 4 above the large two-line name and smaller event information on the green insert.

content_islands.name: Worn context
content_islands.spec: Keep the black clothing visible to demonstrate contrast and practical placement.

reference_purposes.Expression: A green lanyard clip holds a transparent badge against black clothing; the insert places a 4 above the name Orla McCool and smaller National Comedy Awards 2023 text.
reference_purposes.Application: The source demonstrates this treatment in a worn event credential.
